ordering_note: Written before ANY line of ladder_qb1c2.json was read. The ladder process was already launched when this was authored (it takes ~15 min); no output from it had been inspected, and the thresholds below are stated in advance of it. The in-situ numbers this prices off are older than this pass: they come from c12-profiled-fold runs/msal_prof, committed on origin/wk/c12-profiled-fold.

in_situ_per_call_ms.source: mean over the 11 MSALayer calls in c12-profiled-fold/runs/msal_prof/ops_perf_results.csv.gz, DEVICE KERNEL DURATION, 512 aa, qb2 p300c, during-sampled 1350 MHz

predictions.lever: fold the 1/S scale into `a` (2.10 MB) instead of multiplying z (536.87 MB)
predictions.rate_multiplied: the deleted op's OWN in-situ device kernel duration, 3.0227 ms/call x 16 calls
predictions.bit_exact: expected exact at 512 aa: S=64 so the scale is 2^-6 and a power-of-two scale commutes with bf16 rounding. Checked against a float64 reference, not asserted.
predictions.negative_if: the 3.0227 ms op is NOT the z-scale multiply. Its profiler operand field reads 1x1x64x32 logical 64x4, which cannot be a 3 ms op, so the identification rests on position in the op stream and on 536.87 MB x 2 / 3.0227 ms = 355 GB/s being a plausible in-place bf16 rate. The op-level arm mul_scale_z settles it: if a standalone multiply on (512,512,1024) does not land within 15 % of 3.0227 ms, the identification is wrong and this prediction is withdrawn.

predictions.lever: proj_o with the 512-deep batch merged into M: linear((I*J, 1024), (1024,128)) instead of linear((1,I,J,1024), (1024,128))
predictions.why_no_number: this is a re-blocking of an existing ttnn op, not a novel kernel, so it gets measured before it gets a number. Thresholds pre-registered instead.
predictions.negative_if: projo_flat/projo_batched >= 0.95, or reshape_2d costs more than 0.10 ms (it must be a free leading-dim merge, and it is already known value-exact)

predictions.lever: delete the 2.8829 ms transpose by ordering b as (J,D,S) so the regroup becomes a tile-byte reinterpretation
predictions.status: REFUTED AT SOURCE before any timing: ttnn.reshape is defined on LOGICAL indices, so (I,C,J*D)->(I*J,C,D) is a real copy with different semantics, not the byte reinterpret the mechanism needs. Scored against a float64 reference at I=J=64: the arm read 1.417e-2 max error against the shipped path's 1.105e-3, i.e. WRONG, not merely reassociated.

accuracy_bar: 512 aa kill bar 0.60 A with a 1.84 A seed floor beside it. Bit-exactness is measured where free but does not gate.
